
{{alias}}( offsets, inc )
    Increments index offsets according to a list of increments.

    The function mutates the input array.

    Parameters
    ----------
    offsets: ArrayLike<integer>
        Index offsets.

    inc: ArrayLike<integer>
        Increments.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ArrayLike<integer>
        Input array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( [ 0, 1 ], [ 2, 3 ] )
    [ 2, 4 ]

    See Also
    --------
